, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: At the first search for “Peter Matthiessen cause of death,” WebSurfer surfaced DuckDuckGo’s auto-generated “Search Assist” claiming lymphoma and did not follow the Planner’s instruction to open authoritative sources and extract the stated cause with citations. By not clicking through to reliable obituaries (e.g., NYT, LA Times, NPR) and verifying, WebSurfer allowed an incorrect/unsupported cause to enter the workflow and kept returning search pages instead of validated information, leading to an incorrect or unresolved solution.
